Batch scrape with aggressive preprocessing configuration

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import batch_scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(content={"preprocessing_preset": "aggressive"})
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    urls = ["https://example.com/article1", "https://example.com/article2"]
    result = await batch_scrape(engine, urls)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
